events.title: Use the whole time budget, not 10 steps
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: three of four traces (count-dataset-tokens, dna-insert, sparql-university) failed after exactly 10 model calls and only 15-58 s of the 180 s, still mid-investigation when the step limit ended the run.
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c000)
+++ agent.py (c001)
@@ -13,7 +13,8 @@
 SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are an AI agent that solves tasks in a Linux terminal.
 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
-MAX_STEPS = 10
+MAX_STEPS = 100  # the real limit is the clock
+SAFETY_MARGIN_S = 10
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
@@ -49,6 +50,8 @@
         {"role": "user", "content": task},
     ]
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
+        if env.time_left() < SAFETY_MARGIN_S:
+            return  # out of time: stop cleanly
         reply = env.llm(messages, tools=[BASH_TOOL])
         messages.append(reply)
         tool_calls = reply.get("tool_calls") or []

events.title: Show stderr to the model
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the harness discards stderr, so failed commands return "exit 1/127, printed 0 chars" with no reason (count-dataset-tokens step 1, sparql-university step 14, dna-insert missing-script), and the model guesses blindly.
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c001)
+++ agent.py (c002)
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@
 
 def run_tool_call(call, env):
     args = json.loads(call["function"]["arguments"])
-    result = env.shell("{ " + args["command"] + "\n} 2>/dev/null", timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S)  # only stdout: stderr is mostly noise
+    result = env.shell("{ " + args["command"] + "\n} 2>&1", timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S)  # the model must see error messages
     return format_output(result)

events.diff:
--- agent.py (c000)
+++ agent.py (c001)
@@ -13,7 +13,8 @@
 SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are an AI agent that solves tasks in a Linux terminal.
 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
-MAX_STEPS = 10
+MAX_STEPS = 100  # a safety net only: the time budget is the real limit
+STOP_MARGIN_S = 8  # stop starting new model calls when this little time is left
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
@@ -49,6 +50,8 @@
         {"role": "user", "content": task},
     ]
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
+        if env.time_left() < STOP_MARGIN_S:
+            return
         reply = env.llm(messages, tools=[BASH_TOOL])
         messages.append(reply)

events.title: Challenge the first "done" with a verification
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the failing runs (dna-insert, sparql-university, break-filter-js-from-html) end after 8-69 s of 180 s with the model claiming success from reasoning ("verified logic manually") without running a checker on the real output.
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c001)
+++ agent.py (c002)
@@ -15,6 +15,12 @@
 
 MAX_STEPS = 100  # a safety net only: the time budget is the real limit
 STOP_MARGIN_S = 8  # stop starting new model calls when this little time is left
+MIN_CHECK_TIME_S = 30  # only ask for a final check when this much time is left
+CHECK_PROMPT = (
+    "Before you finish: re-read the task and list each requirement. Verify every one by actually "
+    "running a command on the real output (run any provided test or checker; do not rely on reasoning). "
+    "If anything fails or is unverified, fix it. Only then give your final summary."
+)
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
@@ -49,6 +55,7 @@
         {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
         {"role": "user", "content": task},
     ]
+    checked = False
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
         if env.time_left() < STOP_MARGIN_S:
             return
@@ -56,7 +63,11 @@
         messages.append(reply)
         tool_calls = reply.get("tool_calls") or []
         if not tool_calls:
-            return  # the model answered in text: we are done
+            if checked or env.time_left() < MIN_CHECK_TIME_S:
+                return  # the model answered in text: we are done
+            checked = True  # one challenge: do not finish on an unverified claim
+            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": CHECK_PROMPT})
+            continue
         for call in tool_calls:
             content = run_tool_call(call, env)
             messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": content})

--- agent.py (c000)
+++ agent.py (c001)
@@ -13,7 +13,8 @@

 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
-MAX_STEPS = 10
+MAX_STEPS = 60  # the 180 s budget is the real limit: runs used only 20-50 s before the old 10-step cap
+MIN_TIME_LEFT_S = 8
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000

         {"role": "user", "content": task},

     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):

events.title: Verify before accepting "done"
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: runs end as soon as the model writes a text answer, even when its only check printed nothing (break-filter: 5 calls, 20 s, reward 0) or was reasoning, not testing (dna-insert: claimed verified, reward 0); 100+ s were left unused.
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c001)
+++ agent.py (c002)
@@ -16,6 +16,13 @@
 MAX_STEPS = 60  # the 180 s budget is the real limit: runs used only 20-50 s before the old 10-step cap
 MIN_TIME_LEFT_S = 8
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
+MAX_CHECKS = 2  # how often a "done" answer is sent back for verification
+CHECK_PROMPT = (
+    "Before you finish: do not trust your belief that it works. Re-read the task, then run a real "
+    "check of the actual result (the task's test or checker, or use the output the way the task describes). "
+    "Empty output is not proof. If anything fails or is unverified, fix it; "
+    "if it all passes, reply with a short summary."
+)
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
 BASH_TOOL = {
@@ -49,6 +56,7 @@
         {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
         {"role": "user", "content": task},
     ]
+    checks = 0
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
         if env.time_left() < MIN_TIME_LEFT_S:
             return  # not enough time for another model call
@@ -56,7 +64,11 @@
         messages.append(reply)
         tool_calls = reply.get("tool_calls") or []
         if not tool_calls:
-            return  # the model answered in text: we are done
+            if checks >= MAX_CHECKS or env.time_left() < 40:
+                return  # answered in text after being checked: we are done
+            checks += 1
+            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": CHECK_PROMPT})
+            continue
         for call in tool_calls:
             content = run_tool_call(call, env)
             messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": content})

events.title: Show stderr and keep output head and tail
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the model works blind: stderr is discarded and output is cut to 1000 chars, seen in all four transcripts (hidden Python errors, unseen test results, files paged in tiny pieces).
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c000)
+++ agent.py (c001)
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@
 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
 MAX_STEPS = 10
-MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
+MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 4000
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
 BASH_TOOL = {
@@ -33,13 +33,16 @@
 
 def format_output(result):
     """What the model sees of a command's result."""
-    output = result.output[:MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS]
+    output = result.output
+    if len(output) > MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS:  # keep the start and the end, where errors and results usually are
+        half = MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS // 2
+        output = output[:half] + f"\n[... {len(output) - 2 * half} chars cut ...]\n" + output[-half:]
     return f"exit code: {result.exit_code}\n{output}"
 
 
 def run_tool_call(call, env):
     args = json.loads(call["function"]["arguments"])
-    result = env.shell("{ " + args["command"] + "\n} 2>/dev/null", timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S)  # only stdout: stderr is mostly noise
+    result = env.shell(args["command"], timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S)  # stdout and stderr: error messages matter
     return format_output(result)

Then make one focused change (one mechanism) to `agent.py` that fixes a failure mechanism you can see in

events.title: Use the time budget, not 10 steps
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: three of four runs (count-dataset-tokens, sparql-university, dna-insert) hit the 10-step cap mid-investigation after only 20-59 s of the 180 s budget, so the loop stopped before the model could finish.
events.diff:
--- agent.py (c000)
+++ agent.py (c002b)
@@ -13,7 +13,8 @@
 SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are an AI agent that solves tasks in a Linux terminal.
 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
-MAX_STEPS = 10
+MAX_STEPS = 60  # a safety cap; the real budget is the time left
+MIN_TIME_LEFT_S = 15  # do not start a new step below this
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 10  # a stuck command must not eat the whole budget
 
@@ -49,6 +50,8 @@
         {"role": "user", "content": task},
     ]
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
+        if env.time_left() < MIN_TIME_LEFT_S:
+            return
         reply = env.llm(messages, tools=[BASH_TOOL])
         messages.append(reply)
         tool_calls = reply.get("tool_calls") or []

events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: three of four traces (count-dataset-tokens, dna-insert, sparql-university) FAILED after exactly 10 model calls using only 18-57 s of the 180 s; the model was still working when MAX_STEPS cut it off.

-MAX_STEPS = 10
+MAX_STEPS = 100  # a safety net only: the real limit is the time budget
+STOP_MARGIN_S = 8  # do not start a model call with less time than this left
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000

     return format_output(result)
